title: spt-app: visualization of SPT liver model simulations

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Institute for Theoretical Biology, Berlin
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
spt-app provides interactive visualization of SPT liver model simulations of zonation-function relationships and drug-induced liver injury. Explore six zonation patterns and eight substrate flows using time-course images and videos from the porous_media SPT analysis.

The application is available at https://sptmodel.streamlit.app. Source code is available at https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/spt-app. For questions or problems, open an issue.
